comment: true false Body-aim animation. Hot-reloads live. For each limb, gains scale the camera look-pitch (up/down) into a rotation about that character axis: pitch = tilt up/down (about left-right axis), yaw = turn (about up axis), roll = tilt sideways (about forward axis). All angles are in degrees of rotation per degree of look pitch. Set a gain to 0 to leave that limb/axis untouched.
